visual.description: Centered headline spanning ~80% width with subtitle below it, single CTA button, then a product screenshot mockup at the bottom half bleeding off-screen — text above, image below, no columns.
Product UI screenshot occupies left ~65% of viewport while a second image occupies right ~35%, both inside a rounded card frame that bleeds off screen.
Single centered text block spanning ~60% width with a large paragraph statement, no columns, no images — pure typographic section on a gradient background.
Company logos arranged in equal columns on a gradient background, preceded by a centered label line.
Left ~45% contains a vertically stacked list of feature items with left-border accent on the active one; right ~55% shows a product screenshot on a colored background card.
Four feature tiles in a 2-column, 2-row equal grid, each containing a feature name, short description, and a product screenshot card with a colored background.
Three feature tiles in a single row of 3 equal columns, each with a headline, short description, and a partial screenshot card visible at the bottom.
Three columns of testimonial cards with varied heights (masonry-style) on a dark background.
Five labeled columns with the rightmost containing a versioned update card instead of a link list, all on a near-black background.
